top_signals.title: Installation of 35-Ton Propeller Sets the Stage for SMM 2026
top_signals.summary: The giant ship propeller supplied by Mecklenburger Metallguss (MMG) will once again take its place in front of the Hamburg exhibition halls. On Thursday, August 27, the maritime heavyweight will return to the exhibition grounds, providing a visible signal that SMM 2026 is about to begin.
